documents.title: Connection resets
documents.text: The client logs ECONNRESET when the load balancer closes idle keep-alive sockets after 60 seconds. Lower the client idle timeout below the balancer's.

documents.title: Network timeouts
documents.text: Requests that hang for a long time before failing usually point to a firewall silently dropping packets rather than refusing them.

documents.title: HNSW tuning
documents.text: Raise hnsw.ef_search to trade query latency for recall when filtered vector searches return too few rows.

documents.title: Approximate nearest neighbors
documents.text: Graph-based indexes find similar embeddings quickly by walking a navigable small world instead of comparing against every stored vector.

documents.title: BM25 scoring
documents.text: Okapi BM25 ranks documents by term frequency with saturation, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization.

documents.title: Keyword search basics
documents.text: Lexical retrieval matches the exact words of a query, which makes it reliable for names, error codes, and identifiers.

documents.title: Password resets
documents.text: Users who forget their login credentials can request a recovery link that expires after fifteen minutes.

documents.title: Two-factor authentication
documents.text: Enable TOTP codes from an authenticator app as a second factor in addition to the account password.

documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Purchases can be returned for a full refund within 30 days if the item is unused and in its original packaging.

documents.title: Shipping times
documents.text: Orders ship within two business days; international deliveries take one to three weeks depending on customs.

documents.title: Kubernetes OOMKilled
documents.text: A pod restarts with reason OOMKilled when a container exceeds its memory limit; raise resources.limits.memory or fix the leak.

documents.title: Memory leaks
documents.text: If a service's resident memory keeps growing until the process is terminated, profile heap allocations to find objects that are never released.

documents.title: Rate limiting
documents.text: The API answers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when a client exceeds 100 calls per minute; retry after the Retry-After header.

documents.title: Backoff strategies
documents.text: When a server signals it is overloaded, wait progressively longer between attempts and add random jitter so clients do not retry in lockstep.

documents.title: TLS certificates
documents.text: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority means the client does not trust the issuing CA; install the CA bundle.

documents.title: Trust stores
documents.text: Operating systems ship a list of root authorities they trust; corporate proxies that inspect traffic need their own root added to it.

documents.title: Daylight saving bugs
documents.text: Cron jobs scheduled at 2:30 AM run twice or not at all on the night clocks change; schedule them in UTC.

documents.title: Time zones
documents.text: Store timestamps in UTC and convert to the viewer's local zone only for display.

documents.title: Git rebase
documents.text: git rebase --onto main feature~3 moves the last three commits of a branch onto main without the commits in between.

documents.title: Rewriting history
documents.text: To clean up a messy series of commits before review, interactively combine, reorder, or reword them, then force-push the branch.

documents.title: Database migrations
documents.text: Run schema migrations under an advisory lock so replicas that start together do not apply the same change twice.

documents.title: Zero-downtime deploys
documents.text: Add new columns as nullable first, backfill them in batches, and only then add constraints, so old and new code can run side by side.

documents.title: Coffee brewing
documents.text: A pour-over needs water just off the boil and a medium-fine grind; steep for about three minutes.

documents.title: Espresso
documents.text: Espresso forces hot water through finely ground coffee at about nine bars of pressure for twenty-five seconds.

documents.title: Gateway errors
documents.text: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway means the proxy got an invalid response from the upstream; check that the backend is listening.

documents.title: Service unavailable
documents.text: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable is returned while the service is overloaded or in maintenance; clients should retry later.

documents.title: Restart loops
documents.text: A pod in CrashLoopBackOff starts, exits with an error, and is restarted with growing delays; read the previous container's logs.

documents.title: Evicted pods
documents.text: The kubelet evicts pods when a node runs low on memory or disk, starting with those that use more than they requested.

documents.title: Expired certificates
documents.text: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid appears when the server certificate is past its notAfter date or the client clock is wrong.

documents.title: Hostname mismatch
documents.text: x509: certificate is valid for api.internal, not api.example.com means the name the client dialed is missing from the certificate's subject alternative names.

documents.title: Connect timeouts
documents.text: ETIMEDOUT means the TCP handshake never completed within the connect timeout, often because a security group blocks the port.

documents.title: Refused connections
documents.text: ECONNREFUSED means nothing is listening on the target port, or a firewall actively rejected the connection.

documents.title: IVF index tuning
documents.text: Raise ivfflat.probes to search more lists and improve recall of an IVFFlat vector index at the cost of latency.

documents.title: Cherry-picking
documents.text: git cherry-pick applies the change introduced by one existing commit on top of the current branch.
